mmd: biased weighted RBF MMD squared; no significance or causal claims
embedding_centroids: L2-normalized mean of L2 sample vectors; equal nominal identity weighting
text_caution: all synthetic same sentence; real varied content; codec and duration still uncontrolled
projection_caution: PCA/t-SNE are visualization only; metrics use original 192 dimensions
acoustic_scaling: pooled observed identity median/IQR; not fitted detector or normalization policy
